description: Qualification gate for the multi-project DePIN adapter catalog, workload runtime, and contribution evidence pipeline. All checks use the local qualification fixture only. No external DePIN provider was contacted.

checks.description: Catalog JSON parses successfully against deproof:adapter-catalog-v1 schema with all required fields present.
checks.evidence: TestCatalogLoad: catalog v1.0.0 loaded with 6 adapters

checks.description: ConfigureAdapter rejects relative catalog paths with ADAPTER_CONFIG_PATH_DENIED.
ConfigureAdapter rejects a non-existent catalog path with ADAPTER_CATALOG_NOT_FOUND.
ConfigureAdapter rejects malformed JSON with ADAPTER_CATALOG_INVALID.
listAdapters returns ADAPTER_CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE when no catalog has been loaded.
Adapter requiring GPU (render-v1) is marked incompatible with reason GPU_REQUIRED on a CPU-only node.
latency-fixture adapter (no special hardware needed) is marked compatible on the test host.
getAdapter returns ADAPTER_NOT_FOUND for an unknown adapter ID.
latency-fixture adapter has status=QUALIFIED in the catalog.
runLatencyFixture produces a WorkloadReceipt with schema, nodeSignature, and isQualificationFixture=true.
runLatencyFixture rejects empty targetAddr with FIXTURE_TARGET_ADDR_REQUIRED.
runLatencyFixture rejects a non-host:port address with FIXTURE_TARGET_ADDR_INVALID.
runLatencyFixture rejects a URL with a path segment with FIXTURE_TARGET_ADDR_MUST_BE_HOST_PORT.
runLatencyFixture returns FIXTURE_TARGET_UNREACHABLE when all TCP dials fail.
WorkloadReceipt node signature can be re-verified from the node public key over canonical JSON.
Mutating a receipt field after signing causes signature verification to fail.
checks.evidence: TestReceiptTamperedSignatureFails: ed25519.Verify returns false after field mutation

checks.description: DispatchAdapter returns ADAPTER_UNSUPPORTED for render-v1 (GPU required).
DispatchAdapter rejects runAdapter without explicitConsent=true.
DispatchAdapter returns handled=false for unknown actions.
listWorkloadReceipts returns all receipts produced in the session.
canonicalJSON produces identical byte sequences for identical inputs with sorted keys.
containsPrefix matches GOOS=linux against catalog entries declaring ubuntu-*.
persistReceipt writes a JSON file at receiptDir/receipt-<id>.json.
checks.evidence: TestReceiptPersistence: file exists at expected path

checks.description: Receipt measuredValue.observedAt parses as a recent RFC3339Nano timestamp (within 30s).
scopeFor returns MANAGE_ADAPTER for listAdapters, getAdapter, runAdapter, listWorkloadReceipts.
checks.evidence: Code inspection: agent.go scopeFor updated; all four actions map to MANAGE_ADAPTER

checks.description: NodeProtocol.SCOPES includes MANAGE_ADAPTER; ACTIONS includes all four adapter actions.
checks.evidence: Code inspection: NodeProtocol.kt SCOPES and ACTIONS updated

checks.description: Fixture receipts carry providerAcknowledgement.available=false and isQualificationFixture=true.
All catalog entries have skrIntegration.status=BLOCKED.
checks.evidence: fixtures/project-catalog-v1.json: all 6 entries have status=BLOCKED in skrIntegration

checks.description: Catalog entries requiring GPS radio, dashcam, or GPU are marked UNSUPPORTED with explicit blockedReason.
checks.evidence: helium-iot, hivemapper, render, geodnet all have status=UNSUPPORTED with blockedReason

limitations: All checks use the local qualification fixture only. No external DePIN provider integration was tested.
isQualificationFixture=true: receipts produced here are not provider-acknowledged contribution.
NODE_SIGNED_RECORD evidence level: the node signed its local observation. Not independently verified by a third party.
PROVIDER_ACKNOWLEDGED_CONTRIBUTION level is not achieved; that requires a live external provider with a verified counterparty.
No Android device test: the Android UI was compiled and the routing was added, but no on-device execution was performed.
SKR integration is BLOCKED for all adapters: no verified SKR interface or counterparty exists.
RAM and disk capacity are not measured in the compatibility check; declared minimums are cross-checked only against CPU count, OS, and arch.
No mainnet spending, token issuance, deployment, or git push was performed.
trustAssumptions: Test host is running linux/amd64 with Go 1.26.4
fixtures/project-catalog-v1.json was authored from official project documentation as of 2026-10-07
The node-agent Ed25519 signing path is the same path used at runtime
